Analytics.title: Analytics
Analytics.invalidRange: Choose one of the supported reporting periods.
Analytics.failed: Analytics could not be loaded. Please try again.
Analytics.definitions: Orders include non-cancelled submissions. Completed Order Value and the average include READY and legacy SERVED orders, using their stored prices. All reports group records by creation date and reflect their current status. These values are not payments received.
Analytics.noOrders: No non-cancelled orders in this period.
Analytics.productsHint: Top 10 by units in ready and legacy served orders. Names use the latest order snapshot in this period; archived or deleted products remain included.
Analytics.timingHint: Start: created to preparing (legacy: accepted). Preparation: preparing to ready. Completion: created to ready (legacy: served). Cancelled orders and missing, reversed or future timestamps are excluded.
Analytics.visitsHint: Visits started in this period. Duration uses valid start-to-close timestamps only; active visits are excluded from duration.
Analytics.billHint: Times run from request creation. Missing or invalid pairs are excluded. Resolving a bill request means staff handled it; it does not confirm payment.
Analytics.noServices: No service calls in this period.
Analytics.tableHint: Up to 50 tables, ranked by non-cancelled orders then visits. Orders and visits are counted by their own creation dates, so a visit may span reporting periods.
Analytics.overviewHint: Jerusalem time. Orders exclude cancellations; completed value includes ready and legacy served orders. DSMenu does not process payments.
